title: Northern Sweden police investigator of the ghost rocket era

tellings.quote: >> Oh, it was a policeman up in the very

plain: During the 1940s wave of ghost rockets, strange rocket-like objects reported in the skies over Sweden, a policeman far up in northern Sweden is said to have looked into the sightings. The Swedish UFO researcher Clas Svahn mentions him only briefly and gives no name or details. He brings it up as one of the early official efforts to look into the sightings.
